हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा।

show.description: Yash, a talented but poor cricketer, struggles against class bias, betrayal, and a cruel system that favors the rich. Framed, humiliated, and nearly destroyed by Hardy and his allies, he fights back with resilience and truth. As secrets unravel, Yash is revealed as the true heir of the Rawat family, reclaiming his identity, dignity, and place in cricket.
